操作: 緑のマスを押してタイルを仮置き → タイルのすぐ下の ⟳ かタイルをもう: Controls: tap a green square to place the tile → rotate with ⟳ just below the tile or by tapping the tile again (it cycles through legal rotations only) → pick a meeple spot with a circle or button → ✓ Confirm (tapping the chosen circle again also confirms). ✕ cancels the placement.
盤の移動はドラッグ、拡大縮小はホイール（スマホは2本指でつまむ・広げる。そのまま: Drag to move the board; zoom with the wheel (on a phone, pinch with two fingers, and move them to pan at the same time) or the +/− buttons. Hover over a placed meeple (tap on a phone) to see its feature and points.
